WORKING WITH THE NSTTF For decades, Sandia National Laboratories’ energy programs have successfully partnered with large and small businesses, universities, and government agencies. With multiple agreements to select from, partners can access our world-class science, engineering, people, and infrastructure. Please see our website or reach out for more information. Several of the contract mechanisms to work with the NSTTF are presented below. CRADA: A Cooperative Research and Development Agreement (CRADA) is a legal document that permits the access of Sandia technologies, processes, research and development capabilities, and technical know-how to the private sector. What distinguishes a CRADA from other partnership mechanisms is the collaborative nature of the work. Through a CRADA, you and Sandia will work together as partners. CRADA partners have first option to license any IP developed jointly. Funding for CRADA work can be funds-in from the partner, or from external funding opportunities. Support from the partner is required in either case. SPP/NFE (Strategic Partnership Projects/Non-Federal Entity): An SPP/NFE Funds-In Agreement is a bi-lateral sales contract where Sandia can conduct work for a NFE Sponsor on a reimbursable basis. Under this type of agreement many of the technologies, processes, and special technical expertise developed at Sandia have been applied to solving problems in the private sector through mutually beneficial, technology partnerships. The SPP/NFE agreement facilitates the availability of Sandia’s unique resources to private industry, state and local governments, colleges and universities, non-profit organizations, international organizations, foreign governments, and foreign companies to validate or improve technologies. TDC: A Technology Development Center agreement allows a company to perform work at the NSTTF with NSTTF staff for a monthly fee. The agreement allows access to the NSTTF facility, use of site equipment and tools, access to staff expertise, and defines a statement of work.
